trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback was verified.
3. **Confirmed recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy across all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 documenting the failing deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health check failures is addressed.
